# P13: spanning frames across many intervals
evs = []
pn = 0
for i in range(400):
    frames = [{"type": "STREAM", "id": 0, "offset": 4 * (j + i * 128), "data_hex": "aa",
               "fin": False} for j in range(128)]
    evs.append(dg(i, 1200, [pk("A", pn, frames)])); pn += 1
for i in range(20):
    frames = [{"type": "STREAM", "id": 0, "offset": j * 4096, "data_hex": hexs(2048, j),
               "fin": False} for j in range(4)]
    evs.append(dg(100000 + i, 1200, [pk("A", pn, frames)])); pn += 1
run({"version": 1, "traces": [trace("p13", evs)]}, "P13 spanning frames")
